senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. אָרַב) [to insert, press into, interweave,]

units: Yalk. Deut. 808 עָרְבוּ את העיסה (or עֵרְבוּ Pi.; not ערכו), v. עִיסָה.

senses.gloss: [to substitute, put in place of,] to vouch for.
units: <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:4:1">Cant. R. to I, 4</cite> <he>אבותינו עוֹרְבִים אותנו</he> let our ancestors be our surety (for our observance of the Law); <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 982">Yalk. Cant. 982</cite>.

<cite ref="Devarim Rabbah 3:3">Deut. R. s. 3</cite> <he>מבקשים אתם שנַעֲרוֹב אתכס וכ׳</he> do you want us to guarantee to you that, if you separate your tithes properly, the mice will not attack your grain any more? <cite ref="Devarim Rabbah 3:3">Ib.</cite> <he>ע׳ אותן והלכו</he> he did guarantee to them, and the mice went &c. Tanḥ. Vayigg. 5 <he>מפני מה לא עָרַבְתָּ את וכ׳</he> why didst thou not pledge thyself for thy brother &c?; a. fr.

<cite ref="Gittin 52b:14">Gitt. 52ᵇ</cite> <he>שמואל אמר מְעָרֵב</he> Samuel explains (<he>המנסך</he> ib. V, 4, v. <cite ref="N00946"><he>נָסַךְ</he></cite>), he who mixes forbidden wine with his neighbor’s permitted wine.
<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 9:13">Koh. R. to IX, 13</cite>, a. e. <he>המערב מים ביין וכ׳</he> who puts water into wine &c., v. <cite ref="C00860"><he>גְּלַבְקְיָא</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Moed Katan 8b:9">M. Kat. 8ᵇ</cite> <he>אין מְעָרְבִין שמחה בשמחה</he> you must not mix one rejoicing with another (e.g. celebrate a wedding during the Festive Week); <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 70">Gen. R. s. 70</cite>. Y. Ber. II, 4ᵈ top; Y. Meg. I, 71ᶜ <he>עי׳ את האותיות</he> if one made the letters of a word of uneven sizes (so that they are not in a line).

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 15:7">Gen. R. s. 15</cite> <he>שלא לעָרֵב את האותיות</he> he said <he>המוציא</he> in order not to confound the letters (by saying <he>העולם מוציא</he>); Y. Ber. VI, 10ᵃ bot. <he>ראשי אותיות</he>; a. fr.—Part. pass. <cite ref="M02092"><he>מְעוּרָב</he></cite>; f. <he>מְעוּרֶבֶת</he>; pl. <he>מְעוּרָבִים</he>, <he>מְעוּרָבִין</he>; <he>מְעוּרָבוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 808:2">Yalk. Deut. 808</cite> <he>וראה הפת מע׳ קיבר</he> and saw that the bread was mixed with coarse flour.
<cite ref="Eruvin 27a:14">Erub. 27ᵃ</cite> <he>כשקרבי דגים מע׳ בהן</he> when entrails of fish are mixed up with the brine; a. e.—
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 20">Lev. R. s. 20</cite> (in Chald. dict.) <cite ref="M02092"><he>מעורב</he></cite>, v. <cite ref="P01261"><he>עַרְבֵּב</he></cite>.

senses.gloss: (denom. of עֵירוּב 2) to lay an ʿErub, to create a symbolical community of residence or continuity of action.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Eruvin 3:1">Erub. III, 1</cite> <he>מערבין לנזיר ביין</he> you may use wine for an ʿErub for the benefit of a Nazarite.
<cite ref="Eruvin 84b">Ib. 84ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Eruvin 87b:16">87ᵇ</cite> <he>עד שיְעָרְבוּ</he> until they connect them symbolically by an ʿErub; a. v. fr.—Part. pass. as ab.
<cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 16:3">Sabb. XVI, 3</cite> <he>חצר המע׳</he> a court which has been made available for Sabbath movements by means of an ʿErub; a. e.

<cite ref="Esther Rabbah 1:1">Esth. R. to I, 1</cite> (ref. to <he>בני התערבות</he>, <cite ref="II Chronicles 25:24">II Chr. XXV, 24</cite>) <he>שהיו מְעוּרָבוֹתֵיהֶן של אבותיהן</he> they were the hostages for their fathers.
<cite ref="Mishnah Chullin 6:5">Ḥull. VI, 5</cite> <he>דם שנ׳ במים</he> if blood (which requires covering up, v. <cite ref="K00581"><he>כִּיסּוּי</he></cite>) has been mixed with water.

<cite ref="Tosefta Terumot 5:15">Tosef. Ter. V, 15</cite> <he>פרוסות … שנִתְעָרְבוּ וכ׳</he> if pieces of show-bread have become mixed up with a hundred times as many pieces of secular bread; <cite ref="Yevamot 81b:4">Yeb. 81ᵇ</cite> <he>פרוסה … שנִתְעָרְבָה וכ׳</he>; Y. Orl. II, 61ᵈ bot.

<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:3">Cant. R. to I, 3</cite> <he>מה השמן הזה אין מִתְעָרֵב … אין מִתְעָרְבִים וכ׳</he> as oil cannot be mixed with other liquids, so Israel should not be mixed with the nations of the world; a. fr.
